name: RMD Number
note: Cook Islands's sheet (its government's own sheet on the OECD's automatic-exchange portal ('Information on Tax Identification Numbers'; the OECD's index page sits behind a bot check and wasn't opened, the sheet itself came straight back)), read 2026-10-30: individuals aren't issued a TIN automatically; it is the RMD Number from the Revenue Management Division, held only once applied for; numeric, 5 digits. Read as given on application, to anyone. No check rule, age, fee or time is stated.

sources.title: OECD AEOI portal, Cook Islands: Information on Tax Identification Numbers (the jurisdiction's own sheet)
sources.said: The individual has not applied to Revenue Management Division for a RMD Number ... Numeric and must be 5 digits, e.g. NNNNN
